publication_rules: Every figure/table/equation/caption/citation is an independently addressable atom where feasible
Do not confuse same text/content with the occurrence of a citation in a particular preprint/version
CITES means declared attribution, not priority or causal contribution
Preserve exact page/section/figure, quote boundaries, version, DOI and archived retrieval receipt
Preprint is not peer-reviewed unless separately evidenced
No paper PDF redistribution absent rights review
